summary: K Wave Media Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing a strategic partnership agreement with IGIS Global Properties LLC, a subsidiary of IGIS Asset Management. The partnership targets deploying up to $2 billion into AI infrastructure over 24 months, with IGIS co-investing or serving as an LP in KWM-led vehicles. The filing is a routine press release and partnership agreement, not a special situation under the defined categories. No specific deal terms, shareholder action, or structural change is involved; it is a forward-looking business development announcement.
